entities.label: Person
entities.summary: François-Armand-Auguste de Rohan-Soubise, Prince of Tournon, Prince of Rohan was a French prelate, Prince-Bishop of Strasbourg. His parents, Anne Julie de Melun and Jules, Prince de Soubise, both died of smallpox when he was still a child.
